messages:
mira: Quick help — prefetcher-service-prod traces suddenly have child spans but no parent spans showing up in Jaeger since last night. Alert: OBS-3211. Any pointers on where to start? https://dash.redwood.ai/d/trace/handoff
leo: Which deployment? prefetcher v2 or the legacy one?
mira: prefetcher v2 (k8s, autoscaled). The sampling dashboard shows a spike in 'span-orphan' rate.
sasha: First things to check: OTEL SDK config in the pod, and whether the async task library preserves context. Often we see the sampler set too aggressively for background workers.
olivia: Logs are in Loki. Quick command: `kubectl -n prefetcher logs -l app=prefetcher -c prefetcher --since=3h` — look for "traceparent" headers and any span export errors. Also see tracing runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/obs/tracing-handoff
mira: thanks — here's the env block from the failing pod: ```
OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=prefetcher
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=always_off
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otel-collector.prod.svc:4317
OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=env=prod,team=prefetcher
```
leo: aha, sampler is `always_off` — that will drop root spans. For background jobs we prefer `parentbased_always_on` or `traceidratio` with a low ratio.
sasha: also confirm that the worker spawns maintain context. If you're using our internal async queue, make sure to call `TracingContext.inject()` before enqueue and `TracingContext.extract()` in the worker startup. Missing inject/extract means tasks become roots without parents.
mira: our worker uses celery-style tasks (python). We don't explicitly inject currently. Does the SDK auto-propagate?
leo: not across process boundaries unless you pass headers/metadata. For python, check the opentelemetry-instrumentation for your queue library — we had to add `opentelemetry-instrumentation-rabbitmq` and a small middleware to attach `traceparent` into message metadata.
olivia: If you need quick traces for a single pod, you can enable debug logging for the exporter: `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf` and `OTEL_LOG_LEVEL=debug` then `kubectl -n prefetcher logs <pod> -c prefetcher --tail=200` — you'll see exporter handshake and any errors.
mira: running a quick local patch: switching `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER` to `parentbased_always_on` and adding a small inject in enqueue. Will redeploy a canary.
sasha: nice — ping here with the pod name when canary's up, I'll watch Jaeger and the sampling dashboard.
mira: canary deployed: prefetcher-v2-rc3-5fdc7 (pod prefetcher-v2-rc3-5fdc7-rl9k).
devops-bot: Canary rollout started for prefetcher-v2-rc3-5fdc7 — 10% traffic.
leo: watching traces now — I can see parent spans for the canary tasks. Looks like orphan rate drops for that pod.
mira: confirmed — child spans now show parent and end-to-end trace in Jaeger. Alert suppressed.
olivia: FYI I updated the Observability dashboard panel text to include the Loki query and the kubectl snippet, and added a note to the runbook about ensuring inject/extract for queued tasks.
sasha: for long-term, consider adding a unit test that enqueues a traced message and asserts the exported trace has parent context. Saves a lot of digging.
mira: will open a PR after flaky test flaps are stable. Thanks all :thumbsup:
leo: if the alert keeps flapping we should lower sensitivity or add a per-service threshold. Happy to raise a tuning PR.
mira: nice — leaving this thread open for 24h in case it resurfaces. Thanks again.
